<b>Полости тела</b> — замкнутые простран: Body cavities are enclosed spaces that hold the organs. The dorsal (posterior) cavity is the cranial cavity and vertebral canal: the brain and spinal cord, protected by bone and meninges. The diaphragm divides the ventral (anterior) cavity into the thoracic (pleural cavities with the lungs, mediastinum with the heart) and abdominopelvic cavities. Choose a group.
Ствол делится на три этажа. <b>Основание: The brainstem has three levels. The basis (red) is white matter: the pyramids, the bulge of the pons, the cerebral peduncles. The tegmentum (green) lies beneath the floor of the fourth ventricle and the aqueduct: cranial nerve nuclei, reticular formation. The tectum (yellow) exists only in the midbrain: the corpora quadrigemina. “Cerebellum” covers the rhomboid fossa.
The thalamus is a filter at the entrance to the cortex. Vision, hearing, skin and muscle sensation, motor programs from the cerebellum and basal ganglia, and memory and emotion signals all pass through it; smell is the exception. Choose a stream: the thalamus opens a “green corridor” for it and dampens the rest (the inhibitory “shell” is the reticular nucleus).
<b>Базальные ганглии</b> — серое веществ: The basal ganglia are gray matter deep in the hemispheres. About 80% of their neurons (caudate nucleus, putamen, globus pallidus), together with the cerebellum and premotor cortex, control movement: learning, skills, assembling movements into a program. About 20% (nucleus accumbens, amygdala) work in the limbic system. Click a nucleus or run the motor loop.
<b>Белое вещество.</b> <b>Проекционные</: White matter. Projection fibers (red) link the cortex with lower levels via the internal capsule. Commissural fibers (blue) join the hemispheres: the corpus callosum, anterior commissure and hippocampal commissure. Association fibers (green) link cortical areas within one hemisphere, such as the superior and inferior longitudinal fasciculi.
<b>Фронтальный срез</b>. Снаружи кора, п: Coronal section. Outside is the cortex, beneath it white matter. On top, the corpus callosum over the lateral ventricles. Medially, the caudate nucleus and thalamus; beyond the internal capsule, the putamen and globus pallidus; farther out, the claustrum and insula. Below: the amygdala in the temporal lobe and the hypothalamus by the third ventricle.

It helps turn short-term memory into long-term memory (NMDA receptors). Click a structure or start the circuit.

Trisynaptic loop: perforant path (green) → granule cells → mossy fibers (orange) → CA3 → Schaffer collaterals (yellow) → CA1 → subiculum and entorhinal cortex (purple). Click “Stimulus”.
<b>Мозжечок</b> — «малый мозг» под намёт: Cerebellum — the “little brain” beneath the tentorium: 120–160 g, 10% of the brain’s volume but more than half of all its neurons. The vermis is in the middle, with two hemispheres at the sides; folia increase the cortical area. Colors show the functional parts: archicerebellum (flocculus and nodulus), paleocerebellum (vermis and medial zones), neocerebellum (lateral hemispheres).
<b>Кора мозжечка: три слоя.</b> Внизу <b: Cerebellar cortex: three layers. At the bottom is the granular layer, the densest in the brain. In the middle is the ganglionic layer of Purkinje cell bodies. At the top, the molecular layer: flat Purkinje dendritic fans in one plane, crossed by parallel fibers (granule cell axons). Purkinje cells are inhibitory and constantly restrain the cerebellar nuclei (light-blue sparks).
<b>Альвеолы и газообмен.</b> Каждая альв: Alveoli and gas exchange. Each alveolus (0.2–0.3 mm) is wrapped in capillaries. The air–blood barrier is thinner than 1 µm, and all alveoli together cover 70–100 m², a third of a tennis court. Oxygen (light blue) enters the blood, where red cell hemoglobin binds it and the cells turn red; CO₂ (yellow) leaves into the air. Surfactant lining the alveoli keeps them from sticking together.
<b>Нефрон</b> — рабочая единица почки. 1: The nephron is the kidney’s working unit. 1) The glomerulus filters 150–180 L of plasma a day. 2) The proximal tubule reclaims all glucose, amino acids and ~65% of water and salt. 3) The loop of Henle builds a salt gradient. 4) The distal tubule and collecting duct fine-tune it via hormones, leaving 1–1.5 L of urine.
<b>Развёрнутая улитка.</b> Основная мемб: The cochlea unrolled. The basilar membrane is narrow and stiff at the base (left), wide and floppy at the apex (right). Sound sets up a traveling wave that peaks at the point tuned to its frequency. There the stereocilia bend: inner hair cells (yellow) signal to the nerve, outer ones (green) amplify faint sounds. The ear splits sound into frequencies the way a prism splits light.
<b>Активный центр</b> — участок фермента: The active site is where the reaction happens; its amino acids lie far apart in the chain and meet when the protein folds. This is lysozyme from tears (structure 1AKI): a sugar chain from the bacterial wall lies in its cleft. Glu35 donates a proton and breaks the bond between sugars 4 and 5, Asp52 stabilizes the intermediate.
<b>Индуцированное соответствие</b> (Д. К: Induced fit (D. Koshland): an enzyme is not a rigid “lock” — the substrate makes it change shape. Adenylate kinase (structures 4AKE and 1AKE) grabs ATP and AMP, snaps shut its “lid” (yellow) and “pocket” (green) and transfers a phosphate: ATP + AMP → 2 ADP. The closed enzyme squeezes out water, which would otherwise hydrolyze ATP for nothing.
<b>Эйкозаноиды</b> — местные гормоны из: Eicosanoids are local hormones made from arachidonic acid (C20), which phospholipase A₂ cuts from the membrane. COX (COX-1 always, COX-2 in inflammation) makes prostaglandin E₂ (pain, fever, swelling), prostacyclin (dilates vessels) and thromboxane A₂ (aggregates platelets). 5-Lipoxygenase makes leukotrienes (constrict bronchi). They last seconds to minutes.
<b>Где работают простагландины.</b> В ги: Where prostaglandins work. In the hypothalamus, PGE₂ raises the temperature “set point” — fever. At the site of inflammation it heightens pain and dilates vessels — redness and swelling. In the stomach it protects the mucosa, in the kidneys it maintains blood flow, and in the uterus it causes contractions (menstrual cramps, labor). Leukotrienes cause bronchospasm.
<b>20 аминокислот</b> — алфавит белков:: 20 amino acids are the alphabet of proteins: a common part (amino group, carboxyl, hydrogen on the α-carbon) and a distinct side chain that defines the group (ring color). All except glycine are L-isomers. Nine are essential (valine, leucine, isoleucine, threonine, methionine, lysine, phenylalanine, tryptophan, histidine) and must come from food. Click a molecule.
<b>Укладка и денатурация.</b> Форму белк: Folding and denaturation. Sequence sets a protein’s shape, but in the crowded cell chaperones help. On the right is the GroEL/GroES chaperonin (PDB 1AON): a barrel of two rings and a “lid” where a protein folds using ATP. On the left is lysozyme: “Heating” shows denaturation — loss of shape without breaking peptide bonds; mild is reversible, harsh is not (a boiled egg).
<b>Тетрациклины</b> (тетрациклин, доксиц: Tetracyclines (tetracycline, doxycycline) bind the 30S subunit by the A site and keep aminoacyl-tRNA out, so the chain stops growing. Broad-spectrum bacteriostatics. They bind calcium and deposit in growing teeth and bones, so they are usually avoided under age 8 and in pregnancy; milk and antacids impair absorption.
<b>Элонгация</b> — цикл. 1) EF-Tu·ГТФ (б: Elongation is a cycle. 1) EF-Tu·GTP (turquoise) brings an aminoacyl-tRNA to the A site. 2) The peptidyl transferase center (rRNA, a ribozyme) moves the chain onto the new amino acid. 3) EF-G (orange) uses GTP to shift the ribosome one codon: tRNAs move A → P → E. 4) The empty tRNA leaves. Switch on an antibiotic to see which step it breaks.
<b>Устойчивость.</b> В большой колонии е: Resistance. A large colony almost always holds rare mutants that tolerate the drug better (orange; green ones are susceptible). The drug quickly kills the susceptible ones, and within 2–3 days the patient feels better. Stop treating a serious infection early, and the survivors multiply — with many times more resistant ones. Choose a scenario and click “Run”.

<b>Ось гипоталамус — гипофиз — щитовидна: The hypothalamic–pituitary–thyroid axis. Hypothalamic TRH makes the pituitary release TSH, and TSH makes the gland produce T₄ and T₃. Thyroid hormones inhibit the hypothalamus and pituitary (red arrows), keeping levels constant. That is why the key test is TSH: it senses a shift first. In tissues T₄ is converted to active T₃. Choose a disease.
<b>Как T₃ действует на клетку.</b> T₄ вх: How T₃ acts on a cell. T₄ enters via MCT8 (green), and deiodinase D2 (orange) turns it into active T₃. In the nucleus T₃ binds the TR receptor (yellow), which sits on DNA with RXR (light blue). Genes switch on for Na⁺/K⁺-ATPase (blue pumps), mitochondria and oxidative enzymes — more energy use and heat. T₃ is also needed for a child’s brain to mature.
<b>Гемоглобин</b> (PDB 4HHB): 2 α-цепи (: Hemoglobin (PDB 4HHB): 2 α chains (light blue) and 2 β chains (pink), each with a heme whose Fe²⁺ reversibly binds O₂. Binding is cooperative: the first O₂ binds with difficulty but shifts the protein from the T to the R state, so the next ones bind more easily. The curve is S-shaped: in the lungs (pO₂ ≈ 100) Hb is nearly saturated; in tissues (≈ 40) and muscles (≈ 20) it releases oxygen. Move pO₂.
<b>Гем</b> — плоское порфириновое кольцо: Heme is a flat porphyrin ring with iron at its center (coordinates 1GZX: O₂ binds at an angle). The iron is bonded to 4 ring nitrogens and the proximal histidine F8; the sixth position is for O₂, and distal histidine E7 holds O₂ and hinders CO. Oxidized Fe³⁺ gives methemoglobin, which carries no O₂. Carbon monoxide binds 200–250 times more tightly than oxygen.
<b>Серповидноклеточная анемия</b> — «мол: Sickle cell anemia is a “molecular disease” (L. Pauling, 1949): glutamic acid 6 of the β chain is replaced by valine (HbS). In the deoxy form the valine sticks to a neighboring molecule, hemoglobin polymerizes into rigid fibers, and the red cell becomes a “sickle”. Such cells block capillaries and are quickly destroyed. Carriers of one HbS allele resist falciparum malaria better.
<b>Желудочки</b> выросли из канала нервн: The ventricles grew from the neural tube canal: two lateral ventricles (I and II) in the telencephalon, the narrow third in the diencephalon, and the fourth in the hindbrain, a four-sided pyramid with a rhomboid floor. The narrow cerebral aqueduct joins the third and fourth. The red beads are the choroid plexuses, which secrete CSF.
<b>Шесть слоёв новой коры.</b> Около ¾ н: Six layers of the neocortex. About ¾ of cortical neurons are pyramidal. Granular layers II and IV are the input (from other areas and the thalamus), pyramidal layers III and V the output (III to other areas, including via the corpus callosum; V to the striatum, brainstem and spinal cord), I and VI integrate. Red: a giant Betz cell; purple: fusiform neurons.
<b>Проводящая система.</b> Сердце сокращ: Conduction system. The heart beats on its own (automaticity). The impulse starts in the sinoatrial node (60–80 a minute) → crosses the atria (P wave) → waits 0.1 s in the AV node so the atria can top up the ventricles → the bundle of His and Purkinje fibers spread it through the ventricles (QRS). T wave: recovery. Nerves and hormones only adjust the rate.
<b>Разрез почки.</b> Снаружи — капсула и: Kidney section. Outside are the capsule and the cortex (with the glomeruli). Deeper lie 8–18 medullary pyramids with loops of Henle and collecting ducts. Their tips (papillae) open into minor calyces → major calyces → renal pelvis → ureter. Artery and vein pass through the hilum.
<b>Кора надпочечников</b> делает стероид: The adrenal cortex makes steroid hormones from cholesterol. The common first step: CYP11A1 cleaves the side chain, giving pregnenolone. Then by zone: glomerulosa makes the mineralocorticoid aldosterone (retains Na⁺ and water), fasciculata the glucocorticoid cortisol, reticularis androgens (DHEA, androstenedione). Choose a zone.
<b>Сагиттальная плоскость</b> (лат. sagi: The sagittal plane (Latin sagitta, arrow) runs front to back and divides the body into right and left parts; the one exactly in the middle is the median plane. “Move” sweeps it through the body to show which organs it cuts. On MRI a sagittal section shows the whole length of the spine.
<b>Фронтальная плоскость</b> (корональна: The frontal plane (coronal, from Latin corona, crown) is parallel to the forehead and divides the body into anterior and posterior parts. An ordinary frontal chest X-ray “flattens” the body into this plane.
<b>Поперечная плоскость</b> (горизонталь: The transverse plane (horizontal; on CT and MRI, axial) is perpendicular to the body’s long axis and divides it into upper and lower parts. CT slices are viewed “from the feet”, so the body’s right side appears on the left.
<b>Олигодендроцит</b> («клетка с немноги: An oligodendrocyte (“cell with few processes”): each process wraps its own axon in up to 100 layers of membrane, a myelin sheath about 1 mm long. Between sheaths lie bare nodes of Ranvier, and the impulse jumps from node to node: 100–120 m/s instead of 1–5. In the periphery Schwann cells make myelin.
<b>Микроглия</b> — самые маленькие клетк: Microglia are the smallest glial cells, the brain’s macrophages; unlike the rest of the glia, they come from the mesoderm. At rest their processes “listen” to synapses and can remove a weak one: this is pruning of the network. After injury the cells enlarge, move to the lesion and devour debris.
<b>Миелинизация.</b> Отросток олигодендр: Myelination. An oligodendrocyte process flattens into a thin tongue and wraps around the axon again and again. The layers stick together and the cytoplasm is squeezed out, leaving a dense white sleeve. In the CNS the oligodendrocyte does this (one cell, many axons); in the periphery, the Schwann cell.
<b>Ток ликвора</b>: сплетения боковых же: CSF flow: choroid plexuses of the lateral ventricles → interventricular foramina → third ventricle → aqueduct → fourth ventricle → foramina of Magendie and Luschka → subarachnoid space. CSF bathes the brain and drains into a venous sinus through the arachnoid granulations.
<b>Оболочки мозга</b>. Снаружи <b>твёрда: The meninges. Outermost is the dura mater, tough as flexible plastic; between the hemispheres it forms the falx cerebri, above the cerebellum the tentorium. Beneath lies the arachnoid, a cushioning sponge. Deeper are the subarachnoid space with CSF and the pia mater with vessels, fused to the brain.
<b>Ретикулярная формация</b> — «сеть» не: The reticular formation is a “network” of neurons from the medulla to the midbrain. It holds the vital centers: respiratory (every breath starts here; blue waves travel to the diaphragm) and vasomotor (heart and vessel tone), plus centers for swallowing, coughing and vomiting and the system that wakes the cortex. Bottom right: their rhythms.
<b>Ядра-медиаторы.</b> <b>Голубое пятно<: Transmitter nuclei. The locus coeruleus of the pons sends norepinephrine throughout the brain: arousal and stress. The raphe nuclei release serotonin. In the midbrain: the substantia nigra (dopamine to the striatum, movement), the ventral tegmental area (dopamine to the accumbens and cortex: reward) and the red nucleus. Turn on “Parkinson’s”.
<b>Пирамидный путь</b> (красный) спускае: The pyramidal tract (red) descends from the cortex through the basis of the brainstem and crosses at the spinal border: the pyramidal decussation. The medial lemniscus (blue) carries sensation: a synapse in the gracile and cuneate nuclei, then it crosses and rises to the thalamus. That is why the left hemisphere controls the right half of the body.
<b>Ориентировочный рефлекс</b> — павловс: The orienting reflex is Pavlov’s “what is it?” reflex. Novelty detectors in the superior colliculi compare the image with the one 0.3 s ago. A flash at the side → superior colliculi → tectospinal tract → neck motor neurons: the head turns before we are aware of it. The inferior colliculi do the same for sounds.
<b>Гипоталамус</b> — низ промежуточного: The hypothalamus, the base of the diencephalon, has more than 30 pairs of nuclei: centers of hunger and thirst, sexual behavior, fear and aggression, sleep and the body clock. With the pituitary it rules the glands: the posterior lobe releases hormones made by hypothalamic neurons; the anterior lobe obeys its releasing and inhibiting hormones. Try the experiments.
<b>Двигательная петля.</b> Кора предлага: The motor loop. The cortex proposes a movement → the striatum (orange) inhibits the internal globus pallidus (blue) → it stops inhibiting the thalamus → the thalamus lets the program back to the motor cortex. Dopamine from the substantia nigra (yellow) eases the launch. This is how the right movement is chosen.
<b>Эпидермис</b> (0,05–1,5 мм) — эпители: The epidermis (0.05–1.5 mm) is an epithelium without vessels. From the bottom up: the basal layer (division), spinous, granular, on palms and soles the clear layer, and the horny layer of dead flakes; it renews in ~4 weeks. Basal melanocytes pass melanin to neighbors, shielding nuclei from UV; skin color depends on the amount of melanin.
<b>Дерма</b> (1–4 мм) — соединительная т: The dermis (1–4 mm) is connective tissue of collagen (strength) and elastin (elasticity). The loose papillary layer holds capillary loops and Meissner corpuscles; the dense reticular layer holds the skin together. The dermis contains vessels, nerves, hair roots, sebaceous and sweat glands. Its papillae form fingerprint ridges.
<b>Матка</b> — полый мышечный орган разм: The uterus is a hollow muscular organ the size of a pear (7–8 cm): fundus, body and cervix. Its wall: the endometrium (renewed monthly), the powerful myometrium and the outer coat. It usually tilts forward over the bladder. The cervix opens into the vagina, an elastic muscular canal 7–10 cm long.
<b>1. Оксидоредуктазы</b> переносят элек: 1. Oxidoreductases transfer electrons and hydrogen: dehydrogenases, oxidases, catalase, cytochromes. They almost always use a coenzyme: NAD⁺, NADP⁺ or FAD (derived from vitamins B3 and B2). The model is dihydrofolate reductase with NADPH (spheres). Example: lactate dehydrogenase turns lactate into pyruvate.
<b>5. Изомеразы</b> перестраивают молеку: 5. Isomerases rearrange a molecule without changing its composition. Triose phosphate isomerase of glycolysis converts dihydroxyacetone phosphate to glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate so fast that only diffusion limits it, making it one of the most “perfect” enzymes. The model is the yeast enzyme with an intermediate analog.
<b>Оксигеназный путь.</b> <b>Монооксиген: Oxygenase pathway. Monooxygenases (cytochrome P450 of the liver and adrenals) insert one O atom into a substrate; the other goes to water: RH + O₂ + NADPH + H⁺ → ROH + H₂O + NADP⁺. This detoxifies drugs and makes steroids, bile acids and vitamin D. Dioxygenases insert both atoms.
<b>Без каталазы и глутатионпероксидазы</: Without catalase and glutathione peroxidase H₂O₂ builds up and, with iron, forms •OH. Glutathione peroxidase needs selenium, and NADPH from the pentose phosphate pathway regenerates glutathione — so in G6PD deficiency red cells are destroyed by oxidative stress (after fava beans or certain drugs).
<b>Малая доза аспирина</b> (75–150 мг в: Low-dose aspirin (75–150 mg a day). A platelet has no nucleus and cannot make new COX, so it lacks thromboxane for its 7–10 days. Endothelium resynthesizes COX within hours, so prostacyclin is preserved. Fewer clots form on plaques, preventing repeat heart attacks and strokes. The price: bleeding and ulcer risk.
<b>Первичная структура</b> — последовате: Primary structure is the sequence of amino acids joined by peptide bonds (–CO–NH–); a gene encodes it. Everything else depends on it: replacing glutamate with valine at position 6 of the hemoglobin β chain causes sickle cell anemia. The β chain’s 146 amino acids run along the ribbon from the blue N-terminus to the red C-terminus.
<b>Аминогликозиды</b> (гентамицин, амика: Aminoglycosides (gentamicin, amikacin) bind the 30S decoding center (helix h44 of 16S rRNA). The ribosome accepts “near-cognate” tRNAs, and wrong amino acids enter proteins. They are bactericidal but useless against anaerobes (uptake needs oxygen-dependent transport). They are oto- and nephrotoxic.
<b>Левомицетин</b> (хлорамфеникол) садит: Chloramphenicol binds the peptidyl transferase center of 50S, so no peptide bond forms; linezolid binds here too. It also inhibits mitochondrial ribosomes: reversible bone marrow suppression and, rarely, irreversible aplastic anemia; in newborns, “gray baby syndrome”.
<b>Макролиды</b> (эритромицин, азитромиц: Macrolides (erythromycin, azithromycin) bind the 50S exit tunnel: a chain of a few amino acids hits the antibiotic and the peptidyl-tRNA drops off. Used in penicillin allergy and atypical pneumonia. Side effects: QT prolongation, CYP3A4 inhibition (risky drug combinations), diarrhea. Resistance: 23S rRNA methylation (erm genes).
<b>Курс, назначенный врачом</b> (здесь 7: The prescribed course (7 days here). The drug suppresses susceptible and moderately resistant bacteria, and immunity finishes off the latter: the colony is gone. Length is matched to the infection and kept short, because extra days select resistant bacteria in our own flora. The rule: take exactly what is prescribed, never “just in case”.
<b>Латерализация.</b> Левое полушарие: п: Lateralization. Left hemisphere: right visual field, right-hand touch, vocabulary and meaning of speech, writing. Right: left visual field, left hand, emotional tone of speech, spatial imagination, music. The hemispheres constantly exchange signals via the corpus callosum (blue streams).
<b>Гиппокамп</b> («морской конёк», описа: Hippocampus (“seahorse”), the key archicortex structure, lies deep in the temporal lobe on the floor of the lateral ventricle’s inferior horn. Memory of the day, spatial learning, a “catalog” of long-term memory. It keeps making new neurons and can grow with training: it is larger in taxi drivers.
<b>Почки</b> — парные органы бобовидной: The kidneys are paired bean-shaped organs (10–12 cm, 150 g) on the back abdominal wall at T12–L2; the right one sits lower because of the liver. About 1.2 L of blood a minute flows through them, a quarter of cardiac output. They clean the blood, balance water, salt and acidity, and make renin and erythropoietin.
<b>Жажда: выделяется АДГ (вазопрессин).<: Thirst: ADH (vasopressin) is released. The hypothalamus senses “thicker” blood, and the posterior pituitary releases antidiuretic hormone. Aquaporin water channels open in the collecting duct wall, and water leaves into the salty medulla (light-blue sparks). Urine is scant, concentrated and dark.
<b>Наследственная непереносимость фрукто: Hereditary fructose intolerance (aldolase B defect). Fructose-1-phosphate builds up and “locks up” phosphate: ATP falls (the bar), glycogenolysis and gluconeogenesis stall. After sweets, fruit or honey come severe hypoglycemia, vomiting, liver and kidney damage. Children learn to avoid sweets. Treatment: no fructose, sucrose or sorbitol.
<b>Начало гена β-глобина.</b> Верхние ря: The start of the β-globin gene. Top rows: the two DNA strands; below, the mRNA (U instead of T); under it, the protein: the ribosome reads each three-nucleotide codon as one amino acid by the genetic code. Here: Met-Val-His-Leu-Thr-Pro-Glu-Glu-Lys-Ser-Ala-Val-Thr… Choose a mutation type and the protein is recalculated with the real code.
<b>Болезнь Аддисона</b> — разрушение кор: Addison’s disease is destruction of the adrenal cortex (usually autoimmune). No cortisol or aldosterone: weakness, low blood pressure and glucose, salt craving, Na⁺ loss and K⁺ rise. Without feedback the pituitary pours out ACTH; its precursor also yields melanocyte-stimulating hormone, so the skin darkens. Addisonian crisis is dangerous; treatment is hormone replacement.
<b>Астроциты</b> — самые крупные и много: Astrocytes are the largest and most numerous glial cells. Their end feet sheathe capillaries and support the blood–brain barrier (the barrier itself is endothelial tight junctions). Astrocytes clear transmitters, regulate ions and water, and form scars.
<b>Сердце.</b> Боль при стенокардии и ин: Heart. Angina and heart-attack pain is felt behind the breastbone and on the left, spreading to the left arm (inner side), neck and lower jaw. Cardiac fibers enter the spinal cord at T1–T4, where nerves from the chest skin and inner arm also arrive (T1–T2; C8 at the little finger). Neck and jaw: via the vagus and cervical segments.
<b>Остеоартроз</b> — самая частая болезн: Osteoarthritis is the most common joint disease: cartilage wears away (age, injury, excess weight), the joint space narrows, the bone beneath hardens and osteophytes grow at the margins. Limited movement, crepitus, pain on loading, brief morning stiffness. Treatment: exercise, weight loss, painkillers, and joint replacement if destroyed.
